Second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values and risk-neutral bidders: the weakly dominant strategy is to bid your true value. Shading does not improve expected payoff because payment equals the second-highest bid when winning. One round only, so no dynamic considerations. Values are uniform and independent; bids in $0.1 increments; my value is exactly $34, so bid 34.0. Ties, if any, are random and do not justify deviation. This maximizes expected profit.
